title: Service Cloud Contact Centre and Case Management Overhaul
raw_text: Aldergate Insurance plc is replacing an on-premises case management system used by 600 contact centre staff across two sites. The engagement covers implementation of Salesforce Service Cloud, migration of 14 years of open and closed case history, and redesign of the adviser workspace. Telephone, email, and web channels must be unified into one queue with routing by product and policy tier. An integration is required to our policy administration system so case status and policy data stay consistent. We expect a phased cutover with a parallel-run period, and change management training for all advisers.
requirements: Salesforce Service Cloud implementation with unified omnichannel queue
Migration of 14 years of open and closed case history
Integration to policy administration for case and policy consistency
Phased cutover, parallel-run period, and adviser change management
